name: ESS
shortDescription: 8-item standard measure of general daytime sleepiness across everyday situations.
timeframe: In recent times, how likely are you to doze off or fall asleep in the following situations (not just feeling tired)?

questions.text: Sitting, inactive, in a public place (e.g., a theater or a meeting)
As a passenger in a car for an hour without a break
Lying down to rest in the afternoon when circumstances permit
Sitting quietly after a lunch without alcohol
In a car, while stopped for a few minutes in traffic

scoring.formulaDescription: Sum of all 8 situational items scored 0–3 each (range 0–24). Scores above 10 indicate excessive daytime sleepiness.
